dedupe_keys.name: uav laser scanning and photogrammetry of tum downtown campus

description: Technical University of Munich publishes UAV laser-scanning and photogrammetry observations of its downtown campus as part of TUM2TWIN. The selected Zenodo release is version 1.0, published on 23 December 2024. Native subset documentation describes a DJI Matrice 350 RTK with a Zenmuse L2 scanner, RTK georeferencing and nadir acquisition at 75 metres above ground, supplemented by oblique facade observations. Photogrammetric processing produces point clouds, orthophotos and a three-dimensional mesh from the same campaign. These outputs form one release and are not counted as separate datasets. The spatial coverage is the campus site in Munich, Germany. Zenodo identifies open access and CC BY 4.0; linked files are freely available. Complete format and acquisition-date details were not established from the reviewed metadata. Caveats include different processing paths for measured and photogrammetric geometry. The selected release is not asserted to be the latest version. These building and street observations support the TUM2TWIN digital twin and relate to the aggregate benchmark. No imagery or point clouds were retrieved.
